> <span id="rem:g-normalization">**Remark**</span>
>
> *Remark 14*. The normalization $`g`$ is part of the data. The theorem
> does not assert that an abstract formal series canonically determines
> the primitive lattice on which it should be interpreted. Once the
> exceptional ray and its lattice normalization are fixed, however, the
> forcing coefficients determine all local GV multiplicities on that
> ray.
